svg.title: Work — tam11a
svg.desc: Cuebites Digital (AU), Software Engineer, 2026 — Present: Orchestrating the delivery of scalable, high-performance software solutions while bridging the gap between technical excellence and strategic business growth. Defined Solution (BD), Co-Founder & Senior Software Engineer, 2024 — 2025: Collaborated with a talented team to design and implement innovative software solutions that empowered businesses to thrive in a dynamic digital landscape. Reserveit (BD), Full-Stack Engineer, 2021 — 2023: Played a key role in developing one of the first restaurant reservation platforms in Bangladesh, streamlining the dining experience by enabling users to book tables online. Planet X Inc. (BD), Jr. Full-Stack Engineer, 2021: Began my software engineering journey contributing to an IoT dashboard application and device code for monitoring IoT devices.
